title: Do We Live in a Surveillance Society? – Prepositions of Place (English Grammar Lesson)
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

sentences.en: Last year, I was walking on the street back home in the UK, and I started noticing just how many security cameras there were around me.
sentences.zh: 去年，我在英国回家的路上散步，开始注意到周围竟然有这么多的安防摄像头。

sentences.en: There were cameras on lampposts, cameras in shops, and cameras at train stations, quietly watching people come and go.
sentences.zh: 电线杆上有摄像头，商店里有摄像头，火车站里也有摄像头，它们静静地注视着人们的来来往往。

sentences.en: Once you start looking for them, you see them everywhere…. on the walls, in buildings, and at entrances.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始寻找它们，就会发现它们无处不在……墙上、建筑物里、还有入口处。

sentences.en: What’s interesting is that most of the time, we don’t even notice them.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，大多数时候我们甚至都没有注意到它们。

sentences.en: We walk in our cities, shop in stores, and commute at stations without really thinking about how much we’re being watched.
sentences.zh: 我们在城市中漫步，在商店里购物，在车站通勤，却根本不会去想自己被监视了多少。

sentences.en: Surveillance has become such a normal part of life that it fades into the background.
sentences.zh: 监控已经成为生活中如此平常的一部分，以至于它淡入了背景之中。

sentences.en: So here’s the question I want you to think about.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我想让大家思考的问题。

sentences.en: When you walk in your city, how many cameras do you think are watching you?
sentences.zh: 当你在城市里散步时，你觉得有多少摄像头正在看着你？

sentences.en: And do you feel safer because of them? Or do they make you feel a little uncomfortable?
sentences.zh: 因为它们的存在，你是否觉得更有安全感了？还是说它们让你感到有点不舒服？

sentences.en: In today’s episode, we’re going to explore what it really means to live in a surveillance society.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将探讨生活在一个监控社会中到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: We’ll look at the benefits, at the risks, and at the ethical questions surrounding surveillance.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨监控带来的好处、风险以及围绕监控的伦理问题。

sentences.en: At the same time, I’ll help you practise using prepositions of place, in, on, and at, naturally and in real, meaningful context in this episode of Thinking in English Grammar!
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在本期《Thinking in English Grammar》中，我将帮助大家自然地在真实且有意义的语境中练习使用表示地点的介词 in、on 和 at！

sentences.en: Prepositions of place show where something is.
sentences.zh: 表示地点的介词用来指明某物所在的位置。

sentences.en: Just like with time (which I discussed in a previous Thinking in English episode), the choice between “in”, “on”, and “at” depends on how specific the location is and how we imagine the space.
sentences.zh: 就像关于时间的介词（我在之前的《Thinking in English》节目中讨论过）一样，“in”、“on”和“at”的选择取决于位置的具体程度以及我们如何想象这个空间。

sentences.en: Use “in” when something is inside an enclosed space or within clear boundaries.Think of in as “inside boundaries”.
sentences.zh: 当某物在一个封闭空间内部或在清晰的边界之内时，使用“in”。把 in 想象成“在边界内部”。

sentences.en: We use in with:
sentences.zh: 我们与以下词语一起使用 in：

sentences.en: Use “on” when something is touching a surface or located along a line.
sentences.zh: 当某物接触表面或位于一条线上时，使用“on”。

sentences.en: We use on with:
sentences.zh: 我们与以下词语一起使用 on：

sentences.en: Use “at” when you are talking about a specific point, not the surrounding space.
sentences.zh: 当你谈论一个特定的点而不是周围的空间时，使用“at”。

sentences.en: We use at with:
sentences.zh: 我们与以下词语一起使用 at：

sentences.en: So what is a surveillance society? Surveillance is the careful watching, monitoring or tracking of people, behavior or activity, usually for reasons related to security, control, and data collection.
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是监控社会？监控是对人、行为或活动的仔细观察、监视或追踪，通常出于与安全、控制和数据收集相关的目的。

sentences.en: This monitoring can happen in physical spaces or in digital spaces, such as through apps and websites.
sentences.zh: 这种监视可以发生在物理空间中，也可以发生在数字空间中，比如通过应用程序和网站。

sentences.en: A surveillance society is a society where people are monitored as part of their everyday lives.
sentences.zh: 监控社会是指人们在日常生活中受到监视的社会。

sentences.en: This monitoring doesn’t just happen in extreme situations or at important moments.
sentences.zh: 这种监视不仅仅发生在极端情况下或重要时刻。

sentences.en: It happens in public, quietly and constantly, as people go about their normal routines.
sentences.zh: 它发生在公共场合，在人们进行日常活动时，悄无声息且持续不断地进行着。

sentences.en: We see this most clearly with cameras. There are cameras in public spaces, cameras on buildings, and cameras at transport hubs like train stations and airports.
sentences.zh: 我们最清楚地从摄像头上看到了这一点。公共场所有摄像头，建筑物上有摄像头，像火车站和机场这样的交通枢纽也有摄像头。

sentences.en: When you walk on the street, you may be recorded multiple times without even realizing it.
sentences.zh: 当你走在街上时，你可能在不知不觉中已经被记录了很多次。

sentences.en: When you wait at a station, cameras are watching everyone passing through that specific location.
sentences.zh: 当你在车站等待时，摄像头正在注视着经过该特定地点的每一个人。

sentences.en: Surveillance also happens digitally. Our data is collected in apps, tracked on websites, and recorded at checkout counters in the supermarket when we pay for things.
sentences.zh: 监控也以数字方式发生。我们的数据被收集在应用程序中，在网站上被追踪，在我们去超市付款时在收银台被记录下来。

sentences.en: Even though this kind of monitoring doesn’t always feel as obvious as a camera on the wall, it still plays a major role in public life.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种监视不像墙上的摄像头那样总是那么显眼，但它在公共生活中仍然扮演着重要角色。

sentences.en: Some countries are often described as “surveillance societies”.
sentences.zh: 一些国家经常被描述为“监控社会”。

sentences.en: China is probably the most commonly mentioned example of a surveillance society.
sentences.zh: 中国可能是最常被提及的监控社会的例子。

sentences.en: In China it is common to use cameras in public places, facial recognition technology on streets, and large scale data collection at the national level.
sentences.zh: 在中国，在公共场所使用摄像头、在街头使用人脸识别技术以及在国家层面进行大规模数据收集是很常见的。

sentences.en: In fact, if you look at the 10 cities with the most CCTV cameras per capita, nine of those cities are in China.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你看看人均闭路电视摄像头最多的 10 个城市，其中有 9 个城市在中国。

sentences.en: However, the city with the 3rd most CCTV cameras per capita is London in the UK.
sentences.zh: 然而，人均闭路电视摄像头第三多的城市是英国的伦敦。

sentences.en: The UK is also a surveillance society. The UK is known for having very high numbers of CCTV cameras in cities and on streets, especially at transport stations and in shopping areas.
sentences.zh: 英国也是一个监控社会。英国以在城市和街道上拥有数量极多的闭路电视摄像头而闻名，特别是在交通车站和购物区。

sentences.en: In a surveillance society, monitoring is not limited to one place or one moment.
sentences.zh: 在一个监控社会中，监视并不局限于一个地方或一个时刻。

sentences.en: It exists in public, follows us on the street, and focuses on us at specific locations throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 它存在于公共场所，在街上跟踪我们，并在全天特定地点将镜头对准我们。

sentences.en: Surveillance is no longer something that happens only in government buildings or at high security locations.
sentences.zh: 监控不再是仅在政府建筑或高级安全场所发生的事情。

sentences.en: It exists in everyday spaces and follows us through much of our daily routine.
sentences.zh: 它存在于日常空间中，并伴随着我们的大部分日常生活。

sentences.en: One of the most common places we see surveillance is in convenience stores and supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 我们看到监控最常见的场所之一是便利店和超市。

sentences.en: Cameras are usually placed on the ceiling or on walls.
sentences.zh: 摄像头通常安装在天花板上或墙壁上。

sentences.en: They quietly record customers as they move in the shop.
sentences.zh: 它们在顾客在店内移动时静静地记录着。

sentences.en: Most people accept this kind of surveillance because it is linked to safety and theft prevention, but it still means we are being watched in a private business that we visit regularly.
sentences.zh: 大多数人接受这种监控，因为它与安全和防盗有关，但这仍然意味着我们在我们经常光顾的私人企业里被监视着。

sentences.en: We also see cameras on apartment buildings.
sentences.zh: 我们也在公寓楼上看到摄像头。

sentences.en: They’re often installed on entrances, on stairways, or on the outside walls facing the street.
sentences.zh: 它们通常安装在入口、楼梯间或面向街道的外墙上。

sentences.en: These cameras monitor who comes into the building and who waits at the door.
sentences.zh: 这些摄像头监视着谁进入大楼，谁在门外等待。

sentences.en: While this can make residents feel safer at home, it also means daily life is increasingly recorded in these residential spaces.
sentences.zh: 虽然这可以让他们觉得在家更安全，但也意味着日常生活在这些居住空间中越来越多地被记录下来。

sentences.en: Surveillance becomes even more obvious at train stations and airports.
sentences.zh: 在火车站和机场，监控变得更加明显。

sentences.en: Cameras are everywhere. On platforms, in waiting areas, and at ticket gates.
sentences.zh: 摄像头无处不在。月台上、候车区以及检票口。

sentences.en: In these spaces, monitoring is expected.
sentences.zh: 在这些空间里，监视是意料之中的。

sentences.en: I’m sure we all expect to have our video taken as we walk through a train station, and many people feel reassured knowing there is surveillance at these transport hubs, especially at busy times or at night.
sentences.zh: 我确信我们都期望在穿过火车站时被拍下视频，许多人感到安心，因为知道这些交通枢纽有监控，尤其是在繁忙时段或夜间。

sentences.en: Surveillance is not limited to physical cameras.
sentences.zh: 监控并不局限于物理摄像头。

sentences.en: Facial recognition technology now exists in our smartphones.
sentences.zh: 人脸识别技术现在已经存在于我们的智能手机中。

sentences.en: It allows you to unlock your phone just by looking at it.
sentences.zh: 它允许你只需看一眼手机就能解锁。

sentences.en: At the same time, tracking happens on social media platforms.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，追踪也发生在社交媒体平台上。

sentences.en: Our behavior is now analyzed in apps and monitored on websites.
sentences.zh: 我们的行为现在在应用程序中被分析，并在网站上被监视。

sentences.en: Even when we are not on the street, our actions are still being recorded in these digital spaces.
sentences.zh: 即使我们不在街上，我们的行动仍然被记录在这些数字空间中。

sentences.en: This creates an important contrast. We are used to being watched in public places like airports and train stations.
sentences.zh: 这就产生了一个重要的对比。我们习惯于在机场和火车站等公共场所被监视。

sentences.en: We accept it, that’s fine. But surveillance is now common in private spaces too.
sentences.zh: 我们接受它，这很好。但监控现在在私人空间里也很常见。

sentences.en: In shops, in apartment buildings, even in our own phones.
sentences.zh: 在商店里，在公寓楼里，甚至在我们自己的手机里。

sentences.en: Governments and companies often argue that surveillance exists for practical and safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 政府和公司经常辩称，监控的存在是出于实际和安全原因。

sentences.en: I think the main justification is always safety, both in public spaces and safety at specific locations where people gather.
sentences.zh: 我认为主要的理由永远是安全，无论是在公共空间还是人们聚集的特定地点的安全。

sentences.en: One benefit is crime prevention on the street.
sentences.zh: 一个好处是街头犯罪预防。

sentences.en: When cameras are visible on buildings or on lamp posts, they can discourage criminal behavior.
sentences.zh: 当摄像头显眼地安装在建筑物上或电线杆上时，它们可以起到威慑犯罪行为的作用。

sentences.en: Perhaps people are less likely to commit a crime in public when they know they are being watched at that location.
sentences.zh: 也许当人们知道自己在那个地点被监视时，他们在公共场合犯罪的可能性就会降低。

sentences.en: Surveillance acts as a warning on the street.
sentences.zh: 监控在街头起到了警告的作用。

sentences.en: Another common argument is safety at night.
sentences.zh: 另一个常见的论点是夜间安全。

sentences.en: Cameras placed at stations, at bus stops and on quiet streets, can make people feel safer when they are traveling in the dark.
sentences.zh: 安装在车站、公交车站和安静街道上的摄像头，可以让人在黑暗中出行时感到更安全。

sentences.en: Knowing there is surveillance in an area can reduce people’s fear.
sentences.zh: 知道某个区域有监控可以减少人们的恐惧。

sentences.en: Surveillance is also used for monitoring activity in crowded areas.
sentences.zh: 监控也被用于监视拥挤区域的活动。

sentences.en: Large crowds at events, in shopping centers, at transport hubs, are very difficult to manage without cameras.
sentences.zh: 如果没有摄像头，活动中、购物中心里、交通枢纽里的大量人群将很难管理。

sentences.en: Surveillance allows the police to track people’s movement in real time.
sentences.zh: 监控允许警方实时追踪人们的移动。

sentences.en: It also allows them to respond quickly at problem spots and perhaps prevent dangerous situations in these busy environments.
sentences.zh: 它还允许他们在问题点迅速做出反应，并可能在这些繁忙的环境中防止危险情况的发生。

sentences.en: Another important function is collecting evidence in investigations.
sentences.zh: 另一个重要的功能是在调查中收集证据。

sentences.en: Footage recorded on the street or at stations can be reviewed later in police investigations.
sentences.zh: 在街上或车站录下的画面可以在随后的警方调查中进行审查。

sentences.en: For businesses, video evidence in shops can show what happened at the checkout and protect staff at work.
sentences.zh: 对于企业来说，商店里的视频证据可以显示收银台发生了什么，并在工作中保护员工。

sentences.en: So surveillance is often justified in society as a way to increase safety, but does it actually do that?
sentences.zh: 因此，监控在社会中往往被证明是提高安全的一种方式，但它真的能做到这一点吗？

sentences.en: Many people say they feel safer in places with cameras.
sentences.zh: 许多人表示，在有摄像头的监控场所他们感觉更安全。

sentences.en: Walking on a well-lit street with visible surveillance cameras can feel more reassuring than walking in an area with no cameras at all.
sentences.zh: 走在一条有明显监控摄像头的光线充足的街道上，会比走在一个完全没有摄像头的区域感觉更加安心。

sentences.en: The same is true at stations, at car parks, at public spaces, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 在车站、停车场、公共空间也是如此，尤其是在夜间。

sentences.en: But does surveillance actually reduce crime?
sentences.zh: 但是监控真的能减少犯罪吗？

sentences.en: Research on CCTV suggests mixed results.
sentences.zh: 关于闭路电视的研究表明结果不一。

sentences.en: In some settings, such as at car parks or in enclosed spaces, cameras appear to reduce certain crimes, particularly theft.
sentences.zh: 在某些环境中，例如停车场或封闭空间，摄像头似乎确实减少了某些犯罪，特别是盗窃。

sentences.en: However, on the street or in open areas, the impact is often much smaller.
sentences.zh: 然而，在街头或开阔地区，其影响通常要小得多。

sentences.en: Crime may simply move to another location without cameras.
sentences.zh: 犯罪可能只是转移到了另一个没有摄像头的地点。

sentences.en: In other words, surveillance may just move crime on the map rather than reducing it in society as a whole.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，监控可能只是在地图上转移了犯罪，而不是在整个社会中减少它。

sentences.en: Online surveillance raises similar questions.
sentences.zh: 在线监控引发了类似的问题。

sentences.en: Tracking behavior in apps or on websites does not necessarily prevent harmful behavior in digital spaces.
sentences.zh: 在应用程序中或网站上追踪行为并不一定能防止数字空间中的有害行为。

sentences.en: Surveillance also affects how people behave.
sentences.zh: 监控也会影响人们的行为方式。

sentences.en: Knowing you are being watched at work or in public can make you more cautious.
sentences.zh: 知道自己在工作或公共场所被监视会让你更加谨慎。

sentences.en: People may speak differently in the office, act more politely on the street, or avoid certain behavior at monitored locations.
sentences.zh: 人们在办公室里说话可能会更注意，在街上表现得更有礼貌，或者在受监控的地点避免某些行为。

sentences.en: In some cases, this can lead to better behavior, but it also can create pressure and discomfort in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，这可能会带来更好的行为，但它也会在日常生活中产生压力和不适。

sentences.en: Surveillance also comes with serious risks.
sentences.zh: 监控也伴随着严重的风险。

sentences.en: The biggest of these is privacy. One major concern is how personal data is handled.
sentences.zh: 其中最大的一个是隐私。一个主要的担忧是个人数据如何被处理。

sentences.en: Information about our behavior is stored in databases, analyzed in systems, and sometimes kept in the cloud for long periods of time.
sentences.zh: 关于我们行为的信息被存储在数据库中，在系统中进行分析，有时会长期保存在云端。

sentences.en: Our online activity is recorded on platforms, tracked in apps, and monitored at different points when we make purchases.
sentences.zh: 我们的在线活动被记录在平台上，在应用程序中被追踪，在我们进行购买时的不同时间点被监视。

sentences.en: Even if this data is collected for convenience or our security, it can still reveal a lot about who we are.
sentences.zh: 即使这些数据是为了便利或我们的安全而收集的，它仍然可以透露很多关于我们是谁的信息。

sentences.en: Another issue is constant tracking. With cameras on streets, location services in our smartphones, and monitoring at multiple different places throughout the day, people can feel as if they are being watched at all times.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是持续追踪。街头有摄像头、智能手机中的定位服务以及全天在多个不同地点的监视，人们可能会觉得自己无时无刻不在被监视。

sentences.en: Surveillance also raises questions about power and control.
sentences.zh: 监控也引发了关于权力和控制的问题。

sentences.en: Who controls surveillance in society? Is it governments, maybe the police, or is it the private companies?
sentences.zh: 谁来控制社会中的监控？是政府，也许是警察，还是私人公司？

sentences.en: The technology firms at the top of these global systems?
sentences.zh: 处于这些全球系统顶端的科技公司？

sentences.en: And just as importantly, who watches the watchers?
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是，谁来监视监视者？

sentences.en: Where is the surveillance system for those who own the surveillance systems?
sentences.zh: 那些拥有监控系统的人的监控系统在哪里？

sentences.en: Looking ahead, I think surveillance is likely to become even more advanced and even more widespread in society.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，我认为监控在社会中可能会变得更加先进和普及。

sentences.en: Technology is developing quickly, and this technology will now expand in public places around the world.
sentences.zh: 技术正在快速发展，这项技术现在将在世界各地的公共场所扩展开来。

sentences.en: One major development is the rise of AI and AI powered cameras.
sentences.zh: 一个主要的进展是人工智能和人工智能驱动的摄像头的兴起。

sentences.en: In fact, these cameras are already appearing on streets and at busy places.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些摄像头已经出现在街道和繁忙的场所。

sentences.en: Unlike traditional CCTV, AI cameras can identify patterns, recognize faces, and track movements in real time.
sentences.zh: 与传统闭路电视不同，人工智能摄像头可以识别模式、识别人脸并实时追踪移动。

sentences.en: This means surveillance is no longer just recording what happens at a location, but actively analyzing behavior as it happens.
sentences.zh: 这意味着监控不再仅仅是记录某个地点发生的事情，而是在事情发生时积极分析行为。

sentences.en: This kind of technology is often used in places like casinos where people maybe have been banned or where people maybe are cheating at a card game.
sentences.zh: 这种技术经常用于赌场等场所，那里的人可能被禁止进入或在纸牌游戏中作弊。

sentences.en: And their cameras can now track and monitor and identify patterns.
sentences.zh: 他们的摄像头现在可以追踪、监视和识别模式。

sentences.en: Suspicious activity can be found on the spot.
sentences.zh: 可以当场发现可疑活动。

sentences.en: Crowd movement in busy places can be monitored, and alerts can be quickly sent.
sentences.zh: 可以监视繁忙地点的密集人群移动，并迅速发送警报。

sentences.en: While this may improve safety at certain locations, again, it increases the level of control in our lives.
sentences.zh: 虽然这可能会提高某些地点的安全水平，但同样地，它增加了我们生活中的控制程度。

sentences.en: Perhaps the biggest change will be surveillance at scale.
sentences.zh: 也许最大的变化将是规模化监控。

sentences.en: With data collected in multiple systems, shared across platforms, and analyzed in powerful databases, it might become possible to track people across different places over long periods of time.
sentences.zh: 随着在多个系统中收集、在各个平台共享并在强大数据库中分析的数据，追踪人们在不同地点长期以来的行动可能会成为现实。

sentences.en: Perhaps we will know where you have been walking on the street, what you have been buying in shops, and what you have been posting on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 也许我们将知道你一直在街上哪里散步，你在商店里买过什么，以及你在 Instagram 上发布过什么。

sentences.en: All of this could be connected into one system.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都可以连接到一个系统中。

sentences.en: So where do we draw the line? How much surveillance is acceptable?
sentences.zh: 那么我们的底线在哪里？多少监控是可以接受的？

sentences.en: And how much becomes too intrusive in our daily lives?
sentences.zh: 多少监控才会对我们的日常生活造成过度的侵扰？

sentences.en: Let’s bring everything together. Surveillance is now a normal part of life.
sentences.zh: 让我们把所有内容结合起来。监控现在已经是生活正常的一部分了。

sentences.en: It exists in our cities and follows us on our phones.
sentences.zh: 它存在于我们的城市中，并在我们的手机上跟踪我们。

sentences.en: Cameras on the street, tracking in apps and monitoring at airports or train stations are just part of modern society.
sentences.zh: 街上的摄像头、应用程序中的追踪以及在机场或火车站的监视只是现代社会的一部分。

sentences.en: Surveillance can offer real benefits. It can improve safety in public spaces, provide protection at night, and help the police arrest criminals.
sentences.zh: 监控可以带来真正的利益。它能够提高公共场所的安全，提供夜间保护，并帮助警方逮捕罪犯。

sentences.en: At the same time, it raises concerns about privacy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它也引发了对隐私的担忧。

sentences.en: When my personal information is stored in a database, shared on platforms.
sentences.zh: 当我的个人信息被存储在数据库中、在平台上共享。

sentences.en: And collected at multiple different points, it becomes harder to know where the observation should stop.
sentences.zh: 并在多个不同点被收集时，就更难以知道这种观察应该在哪里停止。

sentences.en: This is why the debate isn’t simple. Surveillance in a busy station may feel reasonable, while surveillance in private spaces may feel may feel invasive.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这场辩论并不简单。繁忙车站的监控可能让人觉得合理，而私人空间的监控可能会让人觉得具有侵入性。

sentences.en: This balance matters in society. Before we finish, let’s recap today’s grammar.
sentences.zh: 这种平衡在社会中至关重要。在我们结束之前，让我们回顾一下今天的语法。

sentences.en: We use “in” for inside spaces or systems:
sentences.zh: 我们使用“in”来表示内部空间或系统：

sentences.en: We use “on” for surfaces or lines:
sentences.zh: 我们使用“on”来表示表面或线：

sentences.en: And we use “at” for specific points:
sentences.zh: 我们使用“at”来表示特定的点：

sentences.en: As you go about your day, listen carefully to how people use in, on and at when they talk about places in English.
sentences.zh: 当你度过每一天时，仔细聆听人们在英语中谈论地点时是如何使用 in、on 和 at 的。

sentences.en: Try describing surveillance in your city, on your street, and at your local bus stop using these prepositions naturally.
sentences.zh: 尝试使用这些介词自然地描述你所在的城市、街道以及当地公交车站的监控。

sentences.en: And as with all the grammar episodes, I’ll leave you with a final question.
sentences.zh: 和所有语法节目一样，我留给你一个最后的问题。

sentences.en: Do you feel safer living in a surveillance society?
sentences.zh: 生活在一个监控社会中，你觉得更安全了吗？

sentences.en: Or do you feel more controlled at every step?
sentences.zh: 还是说你在每一步都感到被更多的控制？
